title: An Evening of Flamenco and Tapas
text: We had a wonderful time with Pamen. We thoroughly enjoyed the flamenco show and the places we visited afterwards for tapas. She provided wonderful context for the entire evening. She represents what we have come to regard as a core strength of LiV tours, that is that your representatives are truly immersed in their area and share that expertise in a very engaging way
author: okkayo

title: The best of Seville!
text: Amazing experience with a welcoming and friendly guide.  The flamenco show was breathtaking and the tapas were top notch as well. A lot of fun for the whole family and shouldn’t be missed. 10/10!
author: masaru f

title: Fantastic evening with Pamen—great flamenco, tapas, and history. Highly recommend!

title: Fabulous
text:

title: Unforgettable experience
text:
Great atmosphere! In Seville they make you feel at home as if you have lived here for a long time. 
The venues selected for the Tapas were really great and the Guide prepared us with excellent explanations about the Flamenco to the show (wonderful), which then we could follow with a completely different spirit and involvement. 
Very high quality and professionalism, congratulations. I recommend this agency because they are really good and experienced.

title: A unique and fun night with Pamen!
